name: Casdoor
description: Centralized identity and access management platform providing SSO, OAuth2, SAML, and social login.

envVars.description: Password for the Casdoor MySQL database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      RUNNING_IN_DOCKER: true
      driverName: mysql
      dataSourceName: "casdoor:{{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}@tcp({{serviceName}}-mysql:3306)/"
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/conf:/conf
      - {{appDataPath}}/logs:/logs
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mysql
  {{serviceName}}-mysql:
    image: mysql:8
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: casdoor
      MYSQL_USER: casdoor
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
